value.rationale: The defining literature treats complementary Ehrhart-equivalent sections. Preserving two different intrinsic Euclidean edge-length sums strengthens discrete/area symmetry, gives an exact closed profile for all real parameters and heights, and explains why noncongruent sections can have equal perimeter. Half-size cutting is geometrically structural and an explicit violation shows its universal necessity; this is a complete three-coordinate classification rather than an arbitrary slice.
